race.description: Boland Petroleum Super Mdn Showcase Plate
race.comment: SAVAGE SEQUEL (13) is a first-starter by Barbaric for the Sinclair stable. Scored in a trial at Gold Coast and is drawn favourably. Should go well. FRATIANNO (4) has recorded three minor placings from three runs this campaign. Continued the trend at the most recent appearance when third over 1200m at Tuncurry after he was prominent throughout. Has found it tough to break through but lines up well for this and gets his chance. BUNDORAN (7) is another that returns and has run well over this trip. Holds genuine claims fresh. FINANCE WORK (3) resumed over 1120m at Dubbo last start and finished sixth. Fitter and has place claims.
